from machine import ADC, Pin
import time
adc = ADC(Pin({OUT}))
try:
    adc.atten(ADC.ATTN_11DB)
except AttributeError:
    pass
while True:
    lo, hi = 65535, 0
    t = time.ticks_ms()
    while time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_ms(), t) < 50:
        v = adc.read_u16()
        lo = min(lo, v)
        hi = max(hi, v)
    print('PP=%.1f' % ((hi - lo) * 3.3 / 65535))
    time.sleep_ms(200)
